source.agent_access_boundary: The agent read and hashed the four proof files copied into this directory. It did not access the AWS account, S3 bucket/object/version, backup application, or restored D: archive.

reported_backup.interpretation: The backup report size aligns with the screenshot upload amount and is treated as uploaded/deduplicated backup representation, not the canonical restored archive size.

supported_claim: Owner-supplied evidence supports a successful AWS S3 Immutable backup with Object Lock reported enabled and 1095-day retention, followed by a successful full restore whose reported byte size and PowerShell SHA-256 match the canonical Gate F evidence archive.
claim_boundary: The proof files are directly retained and hashed by the agent; the AWS object and restored archive were not directly accessed or hashed by the agent.

The screenshot records backup-application configuration and status, not an independent AWS API response with bucket ARN, object version ID, retention mode, retain-until timestamp, or legal-hold state.

This evidence supports source-backed cloud backup and recovery verification; it is not provider-independent disaster-recovery acceptance or proof that retention controls cannot be changed by every possible administrator.
The accepted candidate and consumed suites remain frozen; no archive extraction, tuning, rerun, filtering, repair, deployment, or promotion authority follows from preservation.
